title: Canonical trimming machine
statement: For a natural number $k$ and a work-tape index $i<k$, define a deterministic machine with Boolean tape symbols and states recording a forward scan, a backward scan with a Boolean flag, or a completed scan with a Boolean flag. It starts in the forward state with flag false; while scanning forward it moves right on a nonblank symbol and moves left into the backward phase on a blank, and while scanning backward it moves left on a nonblank symbol, setting the flag to the conjunction of its current value and the scanned symbol, and moves right into the completed phase on a blank. In the backward phase, when the flag and scanned symbol are both true, it also prescribes writing a blank; in the completed phase it stays in place and remains completed.
caveat: The helper that packages the per-tape action is not defined in the supplied snippet, so the behavior of other tapes and the precise action encoding cannot be stated.
